thread:
Leo Zhao: Hi team - I clicked the 'Add to calendar' ICS from the welcome email and now I have two orientation events: one at 9am PT and one at 9pm PT (same day). Not sure which is correct. Also neither event shows a Meet/Zoom link.
Aisha - People Ops: Welcome, Leo! Sorry for the confusion. We publish both the Google Calendar invite (organizer: onboarding@redwood.com) and an .ics for folks using other calendar systems. Sounds like your client imported the .ics with a TZ conversion bug. The canonical time is 9:00 AM PT.
Sanjay - Onboarding: We had a few older calendar clients that interpret floating times differently which can duplicate events in the local TZ. If you can, delete the duplicate event that came from the .ics and keep the one created by Google Calendar. I'll also re-add the Zoom link into the event description so it shows for everyone. Zoom (backup): https://zoom.redwood.example/j/987654321
Leo Zhao: Thanks. My calendar is Outlook desktop (Mac). Is there anything specific I should do?
IT Helpdesk: Outlook on Mac sometimes keeps the ICS as a separate event. Steps: 1) open the duplicate event > View Organizer (should show onboarding@redwood.com), 2) Delete the duplicate one that wasn't created by onboarding@redwood.com, 3) Refresh your calendar subscription. If the link still isn't visible, open the event on the web version of Google Calendar and check the description.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Redwood New Hire Orientation" 8:00 UTC / 9:00 AM PT - Conferencing links attached. Recording enabled. Slides will be added 45 minutes prior.
Aisha - People Ops: Note for folks in DST zones: the event was created before the DST switch, so double-check your local time. If anyone needs a calendar conversion table (we have EST / CET / IST / JST rows), drop your city here and I'll post it. We'll post the recording and a short 10-min recap clip in #new-hires within 24 hours. :sparkles:
Leo Zhao: Done, deleted the duplicate. I can see the Zoom link in the event description now. Appreciate the quick help!
Sanjay - Onboarding: Great - we'll also pin a short "how to join" note in the event (join via Zoom or Meet depending on your client). See you Tuesday.
Aisha - People Ops: If anyone else hit the ICS duplication or missing link issue, reply with your email + calendar client and we'll resend a corrected invite.
